# checkout calls ledger over mutual TLS: it presents its own certificate and
# verifies ledger against the CA certificate in its own Secret (ca.crt).
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout
  labels:
    app: checkout
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkout
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: checkout
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout
          image: curlimages/curl:8.10.1
          command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |
              while true; do
                curl -sS --max-time 5 \
                  --cacert /tls/ca.crt --cert /tls/tls.crt --key /tls/tls.key \
                  https://ledger.payments.svc/ || echo "ledger call failed"
                sleep 30
              done
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tls
              mountPath: /tls
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: tls
          secret:
            secretName: checkout-tls
